# dsm_user_quota (Data Source)

Read-only data source for looking up an existing DSM user quota.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dsm_user_quota" "john_home" {
  share_name = "homes"
  username   = "john.doe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `share_name` (String) Name of the shared folder.
- `username` (String) Username to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier: share_name:username.
- `quota_size` (Number) Quota size in bytes. 0 means unlimited.
- `quota_used` (Number) Current space usage in bytes.
